title: Charter
summary: Your aircraft, your schedule. Private and group flights for executives, teams, events and safari travel. You tell us where and when, and we arrange the aircraft, crew, permits and airport handling.

title: ACMI
summary: An aircraft and crew, ready to fly. ACMI means Aircraft, Crew, Maintenance and Insurance: airlines and cargo carriers add capacity without buying a plane. You cover fuel, airport fees and permits, and run the flights on your own schedule.

title: Specialized operations
summary: Flights that do not fit a normal schedule: medical evacuations, humanitarian airlifts, aerial surveys, and support for energy and peace-keeping missions. Flown by certified crews, often to remote airstrips, on longer contracts.
